ru_RU.title: Amazon Fire TV
ru_RU.description:
Your entertainment sidekick wherever you go.

The Fire TV mobile app puts the Fire TV experience at your fingertips—whether you're on the couch or on the move.

Discover & personalize your entertainment anywhere: Browse titles and get personalized recommendations. Search for movies, TV shows, and more across all your services. Build and fine-tune your watchlist in the moment.

Easy control & setup: Launch it all on your big screen with seamless control. Enjoy fast text entry using your mobile keyboard. Set up new Fire TV devices quickly and easily.

Compatibility: Requires an Amazon account and connection to the same Wi-Fi network as your Fire TV to launch content to your TV.

Some features require a compatible Fire TV.

By using this app, you agree to Amazon's Conditions of Use (www.amazon.com/conditionsofuse) and Privacy Notice (www.amazon.com/privacy).
ru_RU.shortDescription: Простая навигация, клавиатура, плюс голосовой поиск для тушения телевизора.
ru_RU.changelog:
• A redesigned remote with both directional pad and touchpad controls
• New remote settings: swipe across several tiles at once, and choose classic or natural scrolling
• Helpful tips that point out features you may have missed
• Bug fixes and performance improvements
